updates.title: CVE-2026-105590: Active Directory Certificate Services Security Feature Bypass
updates.summary: A certificate validation flaw in Windows Active Directory Certificate Services allows authorized attackers to bypass security features over the network. Admins managing PKI infrastructure should apply the patch promptly to prevent potential credential or authentication bypass attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-118148: Active Directory Domain Services Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An elevation of privilege vulnerability was identified in Active Directory Domain Services with updated CVSS scoring and FAQ corrections. Identity and access administrators should review and apply patches to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation within their AD environment.

updates.title: CVE-2026-96082: Windows Kerberos Denial of Service Vulnerability
updates.summary: A denial of service vulnerability in Windows Kerberos has been updated with new acknowledgements. Identity infrastructure admins should ensure their Kerberos implementations are patched to maintain authentication service availability.

updates.title: CVE-2026-121680: Windows NTLM Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: An NTLM spoofing vulnerability affecting Windows and Microsoft Office has been patched across multiple products. Admins should update supported Office versions and Windows systems to prevent network-level authentication bypass attacks.

updates.title: CVE-2026-109467: Azure DevOps Server Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
updates.summary: Improper authentication in Azure DevOps Server allows authorized attackers to execute remote code over a network. Admins must patch their DevOps Server instances immediately to prevent unauthorized code execution and compromise of CI/CD pipelines.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Network Data Security DLP Scoping for All Websites
updates.summary: Purview DLP policies integrated with Entra Global Secure Access can now be scoped to all websites or all websites except specific cloud apps, extending protection beyond the Defender Cloud App Catalog. This gives compliance admins finer control over network data protection policies without requiring manual app-by-app configuration.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management Connector Certificate-Based Authentication
updates.summary: The Microsoft Rights Management connector is transitioning from shared-secret authentication to certificate-based authentication, improving security posture. Admins will now configure their own Entra app registrations and certificates using new PowerShell cmdlets, eliminating the need for automatic service principal provisioning.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention Triage Agent Sensitive Data Remediation
updates.summary: A new Data Security Triage Agent function in DLP, integrated with Microsoft Teams, enables admins to automatically detect and remediate sensitive data (SSNs, passwords, credit cards) across thousands of SharePoint and OneDrive files. This dramatically increases remediation rates and reduces compliance risk without manual intervention.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Version Trimming for Retained Files
updates.summary: Admins with Purview RBAC roles can now enable version cleanup for OneDrive and SharePoint content covered by retention policies, allowing storage reclamation while maintaining legal-hold and records compliance promises. This policy-scoped setting overrides the default behavior of retaining all file versions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Auto-Delete for Departed Employees
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now automatically delete both content and containers (OneDrives and mailboxes) for departed users at scale through Purview DLM, eliminating manual cleanup and ensuring tenant compliance without administrative overhead.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Retention policies in Purview can now include archiving actions for SharePoint files, moving inactive content to low-cost storage while keeping it compliant and discoverable. This extends retention lifecycle management beyond keep-or-delete options, reducing storage costs without compromising governance.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Hard Delete via Secure Priority Cleanup
updates.summary: Compliance admins can now perform hard deletion of OneDrive and SharePoint content through secure priority cleanup workflows, bypassing the standard 93-day recycle bin retention with strict controls to prevent inadvertent data loss. This addresses compliance scenarios requiring permanent, immediate content removal.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection Auto-Label SharePoint Files by Library Default
updates.summary: SharePoint files can now be automatically labeled to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library, closing labeling gaps for data at rest. This ensures consistent security-by-default protection across libraries without relying on manual user action.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now supports access to archive mailboxes (main and auxiliary), providing a unified view before EWS APIs deprecate in October 2026. This enables admins and developers to manage archive data programmatically across multiple mailbox containers.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention FTP and SFTP Monitoring
updates.summary: Endpoint DLP now monitors sensitive data transferred over FTP and SFTP protocols with configurable restrictive actions, extending DLP coverage beyond traditional cloud channels. Admins can configure FTP/SFTP transfer activities in Endpoint DLP policies to enforce data protection across file transfer methods.
